Paris    -> 91.2%

caption: A probability for every token in the vocabulary — not a lookup, a learned likelihood.

code:
sequence = prompt
while not done:
    probs = model(sequence)
    next_token = sample(probs)
    sequence += next_token
caption: Every new token re-reads the whole sequence so far — including tokens the model just produced.

subtitle: What happens when a conversation outgrows what the model can hold at once.
